facts.fact: Biometric Update, citing the national news agency, reports the DRC launched the RDC-Pass national digital identity platform in Kinshasa, which supports unified access to e-government services via a single login, with a phased rollout beginning with pilot testing.

Biometric Update reports RDC-Pass, the national digital ID platform, gives unified access to e-government services via a single login and is described as a central gateway for service delivery across government agencies.

systems.platform: national digital identity platform with single login to e-government services
systems.owner: Government of the DRC (Ministry of Planning) with Trident Digital Tech DRC Africa SAS under a 20-year PPP
